CoreBoard.Address_comment: IP address of the CoreBoard (DHCP; printed on its UART log and shown on http://<board>/)
CoreBoard.HttpPort_comment: HTTP port of the streaming firmware
CoreBoard.Frequency_MHz_comment: receive carrier, whole MHz, 2150 to 2800 (match TxLO_MHz of the Pluto)
CoreBoard.SampleRate_comment: 40000000 for Flexlink (40 Msps needs Gigabit Ethernet); 4/8/16/20 Msps also exist
CoreBoard.AGC_comment: 1: the chip's Wi-Fi AGC; 0: fixed Gain (recommended, the AGC is tuned for Wi-Fi preambles)
CoreBoard.Gain_comment: manual gain: PHY gain-table index (not dB), 0 to gain_max (reported by the board)
CoreBoard.Bandwidth_MHz_comment: analog filter, 13 to 54 MHz; 0 = follow the sample rate
CoreBoard.DC_Correction_comment: 1: the firmware removes the residual DC offset (manual gain only)
CoreBoard.CaptureSeconds_comment: seconds recorded (start the transmitter in the first second or two)
CoreBoard.UdpPort_comment: UDP port on this PC for the samples; 0 = any free port
CoreBoard.SocketBuffer_MB_comment: UDP receive buffer asked for (Linux caps it at net.core.rmem_max)
